description: This file defines an Angular component named `RecipeDetailComponent` which displays details of a recipe. It imports Angular core modules, routing modules, and two custom services (`RecipeService` and `FavoritesService`). The component fetches a recipe by ID from route parameters and provides methods to toggle and check favorite status.

classes.name: RecipeDetailComponent
classes.description: Angular component for displaying and interacting with recipe details, including fetching data by recipe ID and toggling/favoriting recipes.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Lifecycle hook, currently does nothing as data is already fetched from route parameters.

methods.name: toggleFav
methods.description: Toggles the favorite status of the recipe with the provided ID.

methods.name: isFav
methods.description: Checks if the recipe with the provided ID is marked as favorite.
